nodes.label: PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation
nodes.author: Yuhan Wang; Zhengxi Lu; Yuchen Yan; Kaitao Song; Wenqi Zhang; Weiming Lu; Jun Xiao; Yueting Zhuang; Yongliang Shen
nodes.rationale: If a question and its grading rubric are pulled from overlapping text, a model can raise score by paraphrasing rather than planning well; drawing question and rubric from disjoint paper sections removes this leakage by construction.

nodes.label: Rubric-as-reward two-stage OPSD+GRPO training
nodes.rationale: Running the entropy-raising OPSD warm-up before GRPO lets the subsequent reward-optimization stage sharpen a richer distribution rather than narrowing a cold-start policy.
